The '''Plasma Shell S3 shield generator''' was a type of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] produced by [[ArMek/Legends|ArMek]] for installation in [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was used in various [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Plasma Shell S3 shield generator was a starship component that first appeared in the first expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', which was released on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. The shield generator required a player in the game to have level four ship equipment certification before it could added to a starship owned by the player. It could be randomly awarded as loot to a player who destroyed an enemy starship.
